newsitem.title: USA: Carbite to acquire remainder of Viper Bite.
newsitem.headline: Carbite to acquire remainder of Viper Bite.

text.p: Carbite Golf Inc said on Thursday it had signed a letter of intent to acquire from Advanced Golf the 49 percent of Viper Bite Co that Carbite does not already own.
Carbite said it would issue 700,000 of its shares to Advanced Golf and grant an option to acquire an additional 700,000 shares for a period of two years at a price of C$1.50 a share.
In June 1995 Carbite licensed its surface technology to a joint venture operating under the name Viper Bite.

Carbite said Viper Bite financial statements through June 30 show a net profit of $1.3 million and a cash position of $523,000. This is projected to increase to a net profit of $1.5 million and a cash position of $700,000 by December 31 and form part of the assets being purchased.
